notes: उम्र (age) is feminine, so it is आपकी उम्र कितनी है? Another common way to ask is आप कितने साल के हैं? ("you how-many years of are?").
साल का / की agrees with the speaker: a man says मैं तीस साल का हूँ, a woman मैं तीस साल की हूँ.
Phone numbers are said digit by digit or in pairs. Many people say the digits in English, and ज़ीरो is as common as शून्य. The numbers here are shown in digits because recognition returns digits.
